200 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully renamed the agent.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
integer
The unique ID of the agent.
string
The UUID of the agent. This value corresponds to the ID of the
asset where the agent is installed. You can use this property
to match agent data to asset data.
string
The name of the agent.
string
The platform of the agent.
string
The agent software distribution.
string
The IP address of the agent.
integer
A Unix timestamp indicating the date and time when the agent
last scanned the asset.
string
The currently loaded plugin set of the agent (null if the agent
has no plugin set loaded).
string

The build number for the agent.
string
The build version for the agent.
integer
A Unix timestamp indicating the date and time when the link
from Tenable Vulnerability Management to the agent was
established.
integer
The Unix timestamp indicating the date and time when the
agent last communicated with Tenable Vulnerability
Management.
string
Enum: "on"
"off"
"init"
The current status of the agent. Possible statuses are:
on —The agent has connected recently and is ready to
scan.
off —The agent has not been seen recently and should
be considered offline.
init —The agent is online, but it is still processing
plugin updates and is not ready to scan.
string
The public IPv4 address of the AWS instance where the agent
is installed.
string
The public hostname of the AWS instance where the agent is
installed.
string
The instance ID of the AWS instance where the agent is
installed.
string
The UUID for the AWS account that created the virtual
machine instance. This attribute only appears for Amazon
EC2 instances.
boolean
Indicates whether or not the agent supports remote logs.

The name of the profile that the agent belongs to.
Array of objects
An array of the agent's remote settings.
boolean
Indicates whether or not the agent supports remote settings.
boolean
Indicates whether or not the agent is pending a restart.
string
The UUID of the asset that the agent is linked to.
integer
The numeric representation of the agent health event's status.
0  indicates a HEALTHY  status, 10  indicates a WARNING
status, 20  indicates a CRITICAL  status, 30  indicates a
SAFE MODE  status, and 999  or NULL  indicates an
UNKNOWN  status.
string
The agent's current health status ( HEALTHY , WARNING ,
CRITICAL , SAFE MODE , or UNKNOWN ).
Array of objects
An array of the agent's previous health statuses.
integer
The numeric representation of the agent's safe mode status.
0  indicates that safe mode is disabled and any value greater
than 0  indicates that safe mode is enabled.
integer
A Unix timestamp indicating the date and time when safe
mode was last modified on the agent.
boolean

Indicates whether the agent is enabled with continuous
assessment scanning via an agent profile.
integer
Indicates the general health of the agent's continuous
assessment scanning health events. 0  indicates a
HEALTHY  status, 10  indicates a WARNING  status, 20
indicates a CRITICAL  status, and -1  indicates that
continuous assessment scanning is not enabled on the agent.
For more information, see the agent Health status description
in the Tenable Vulnerability Management User Guide.
integer
Indicates the general health of the agent's vulnerability
scanning health events. 0  indicates a HEALTHY  status, 10
indicates a WARNING  status, 20  indicates a CRITICAL
status, and -1  indicates that vulnerability management
scanning is not enabled on the agent. For more information,
see the agent Health status description in the Tenable
Vulnerability Management User Guide.
400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters or if your request was improperly formatted.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
A brief description of the cause of the error.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to rename agents.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management cannot find the specified agent.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
— 500
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management encountered an internal server error. Wait a moment,
and try your request again.
